Un thème bleu et noir en hommage à Ado :: A blue and black theme in tribute to Ado: her artwork in the background, blue roses in the corners with sparkling gyaru stickers, Abo (the plush from the "I am Ado" meme) strolling behind the panels and peeking out of each one, a scrolling list of her songs at the bottom and a bold, readable NeoDex title, also on the taskbar. A fan theme, not officially linked to the artist.
